<!-- stormworks-research-gap:category:Propulsion -->
This issue tracks explicit open questions in the [wiki](https://sw-wiki.maxsp.de/parts#propulsion).

The quotations below preserve the scope of each source. A resource-only article can lack a formula that a separate native-code investigation has partly recovered. Reconcile those findings before treating every quoted item as wholly undecoded.

## Recorded gaps

**Practical behavior guidance**

> Force-emitter fields are configuration; their runtime use was not decoded.

- [wiki/data/behavior.json](https://github.com/Chaoscaot/stormworks-wiki/blob/main/wiki/data/behavior.json), `/categories/13/limitations/0`

**Practical behavior guidance**

> Whether force_emitter_max_force is a thrust cap and how RPS maps to thrust were not recovered; measure thrust against RPS with a fixed test rig.

- [wiki/data/behavior.json](https://github.com/Chaoscaot/stormworks-wiki/blob/main/wiki/data/behavior.json), `/categories/13/sections/2/body`

## Completion criteria

- Recover the relevant routine or run a reproducible measurement against the identified game build.
- Record equations, units, bounds, assumptions and executable addresses or measurement inputs.
- Update the wiki guidance and its extractor, retaining citations and any remaining uncertainty.
- Add or update an interactive graph when the recovered formula supports one.
- Re-run the relevant source checks and website checks.
title: Propulsion: decode remaining behavior and formulas
